change_summary: Reduce OAuth access token expiry from 24h to 1h to improve security posture per audit finding SEC-2024-031
diff_or_config:
# config/oauth-server.yaml
oauth:
  issuer: https://auth.company.com
  access_token:
-   expiry: 86400
+   expiry: 3600
    signing_algorithm: RS256
  refresh_token:
    expiry: 604800
    rotation: true
service_context: identity-service (Java/Spring), serves all authenticated traffic. 1.2M active users, ~340k concurrent sessions at peak.
observability_evidence: Grafana dashboard: grafana.internal/d/auth-service-overview showing token issuance rate, refresh rate, and error counts.
slo_reliability_impact: Token refresh traffic will increase ~24x. Refresh endpoint currently handles 14k req/h, expected 336k req/h post-change.
validation_evidence: Tested in staging environment for 1 hour with synthetic load. 0 auth errors observed. Refresh endpoint p99 stayed under 50ms.

seeded_gaps.description: No staged rollout plan; 'deploy to prod' gives no progressive delivery strategy
No rollback plan for reverting token expiry if refresh endpoint saturates
No alerting for refresh endpoint saturation or auth failure spike
No owner or on-call team identified for the change
